name: data-data-platform
description: Use when the user asks to design an end-to-end data platform: storage/compute separation, S3/ADLS/GCS, Spark and Trino, catalog, orchestration and data platforms on Kubernetes (Strimzi, Spark operator). Produces a platform architecture with component choices and interfaces. Not for one component in depth (use data-data-lakehouse or data-streaming).
